payer_id.description: Whose rate this is (payer_aliases.yaml id) for payer-specific rows (hospital MRF payer rows, TiC); None for fee schedules, cash and chargemaster prices. Lets the quote check that a BCBS receipt only sums BCBS rates.
payer_id.title: Payer Id

row_id.description: RateRow.row_id (<nk_hash>:<nk_ordinal>), unique per build. Required on insurer TiC numbers: one TiC price row (one row_ref) is shared by every provider group listed with it, so only row_id says which group's number this is (P1 problem 1).
row_id.title: Row Id

source_file.description: Basename only; never an absolute or relative path.
source_file.title: Source File

source_id.description: Sources registry id. The UI's source chip is derived from this (never stored separately), so a number cannot sit next to another file's chip.
source_id.title: Source Id
